# Module: `icescopy_droplet_training_io`

Reads annotated frames and linked images from Icescopy sessions for detector training.

[Source](../src/icescopy_droplet_training_io.py) | [API index](API-Reference.md)

Reads bounded session JSON from the session archive and exposes saved current-frame and keyframe annotations. Resolves linked media relative to the session or a supplied relink folder, validates requested frames, and loads raw RGB pixels with their circles. Does not restore result CSV tables or modify the saved session.

## Classes

| Class | Role |
| --- | --- |
| [`TrainingSessionError`](API-Class-TrainingSessionError.md) | Reports invalid training-session contents or unavailable linked media. |
| [`TrainingFrame`](API-Class-TrainingFrame.md) | Identifies one saved annotated frame and its circles. |
| [`TrainingSession`](API-Class-TrainingSession.md) | Holds parsed session metadata, available annotated frames, and an optional relink folder. |
